name: Saat ve Saat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Saat ve Saat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a distributor and retailer of watches and accessories for men and women. The company offers classic watches, sports watches, and smartwatches. It also sells jewelry, including necklaces, earrings, rings, bracelets, brooches, and bangles, as well as accessories such as bags, watch boxes, cords, perfumes, key chains, charms, pens, and scarves. It sells its products through the internet and retail stores. The company serves consumers in Turkey. The company was founded in 1971 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
